info.title: CalCraft API
info.description: REST API of CalCraft. Authenticate with POST /v1/auth/login; the session is a cookie. Every state-changing request needs the x-calcraft-request header (CSRF protection).

get.summary: Server name, version and source code location

get.description: Lets the UI decide whether to show an SSO button.

post.summary: Log in; sets the session cookie

get.description: Browser navigation, not an XHR call. Redirects to the identity provider (Authorization Code flow with PKCE) and sets a short-lived cookie that binds the login to this browser. 404 if SSO is not configured.

303.description: Redirect to the identity provider, or to /?sso_error=unavailable

get.description: Called by the browser when the identity provider redirects back. Validates state, browser binding, code and ID token, maps the identity to a local account, sets the session cookie and redirects to /. On failure redirects to /?sso_error=CODE with CODE one of invalid_request, denied, unavailable, login_failed, no_account, account_exists (existing local account not approved for this IdP subject), local_2fa_required. 404 if SSO is not configured.

parameters.name: iss
parameters.description: RFC 9207 issuer identifier; must match the configured issuer if present

303.description: Redirect to / (logged in, Set-Cookie with the session) or to /?sso_error=CODE

post.summary: Change the password; ends all sessions
Create a new TOTP secret (not yet active)
Activate 2FA with a first code; returns recovery codes once
Create an app password; the password is shown once
Create a calendar or address book

delete.summary: Delete a collection and all its objects

patch.summary: Enable/disable a user or change admin rights (admins only)

delete.summary: Remove the SSO link of a user (admins only)
delete.description: Removes the OpenID Connect identities bound to the user (like `calcraft user unbind-sso`) and ends the user's web sessions. The account can only be linked again after an operator approval (`calcraft user allow-sso-link`). Admins cannot unlink themselves (409). The IdP subject is never returned or logged.

get.summary: Result of the optional update check (admins only)
get.description: With [updates] check = true the server asks api.github.com for the latest release at startup and every interval_hours (GitHub sees the server's IP address and User-Agent; nothing else is sent). Drafts and pre-releases are ignored. enabled is false when the check is off or not compiled in.

get.summary: Download a calendar or address book as one file
get.description: Streams all objects of the collection. The response has Content-Disposition: attachment. CSV cells starting with =, +, -, @, TAB or CR are prefixed with ' (formula neutralisation).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: File format. Calendars: ics (default), jcal, xcal, csv. Address books: vcf (default), jcard, csv.

post.summary: Import a file into a calendar or address book
post.description: The body is the file (at most 20 MiB and server.max_body_bytes, at most 10000 objects). Every object is validated like a DAV PUT; storage quota and object limits apply. Events, to-dos and journals are grouped by UID with their recurrence overrides.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: File format. Calendars: ics (default), jcal, xcal, csv. Address books: vcf (default), jcard, csv.

parameters.name: on_conflict
parameters.description: What to do when an object with the same UID already exists in the collection.

get.summary: List the trash of the logged-in user
get.description: Deleted objects and collections, newest first. Entries are purged after storage.trash_retention_days (retention_days in the response; 0 = trash disabled). Their bytes count towards the storage quota until they are restored, deleted or purged.

delete.description: Deletes all entries of the logged-in user permanently. They disappear and stop counting towards the quota at once; the rows are removed by the background purge shortly after.

post.description: Puts an object back into its original collection under its original name, or recreates a collection with all its objects. DAV clients see the restored objects as new changes (sync-collection). Conflicts answer 409 with error = name_taken, uid_taken, collection_exists, collection_in_trash (restore the collection first) collection_deleted (restore into another collection with ?collection=) or invalid_target.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Opaque entry id (32 hex digits) from the listing. Ids of other users are answered like unknown ids.

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: Restore an object into this collection (short name, same kind) instead of its original one, e.g. when that was deleted permanently (collection_deleted). Not allowed for collection entries.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Opaque entry id (32 hex digits) from the listing. Ids of other users are answered like unknown ids.

Csrf.name: x-calcraft-request
Csrf.description: Any value; required on state-changing requests.

sso.description: Link of this account to the configured single sign-on; null if SSO is not configured. Only ever describes the logged-in user; the IdP subject is never included.

linked.description: The account is bound to an identity of issuer.

linked_at.description: When the identity was bound (Unix seconds).

sso_linked.description: The account is bound to an SSO (OpenID Connect) identity of any issuer.

latest.description: Latest stable release (X.Y.Z), once a check succeeded

password.description: Login with username and password (false if security.password_login is off)

oidc.description: Single sign-on, null if not configured

errors.description: Reasons for the first 20 rejected objects

name.description: Resource name of an object; null for collections

summary.description: SUMMARY, FN or collection display name (plain text, untrusted)

etag.description: Entity tag of a restored object (unchanged)
